title: Regret-Optimal Wasserstein-Robust Linear Regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.42109v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) minimizes worst-case risk under distributional uncertainty, but its decisions can be suboptimal in terms of their excess risk, or regret. We study this gap for multivariate least-squares regression, assuming that the observed source law and unknown target law differ by an adversarial 2-Wasserstein perturbation of size $\varepsilon$. We first identify the asymptotic complexity of robust decision-making in the $\varepsilon \to 0$ limit, characterized by a problem-specific condition number $\kappa$. Here, a wide spectrum of simple algorithms, including DRO, achieve the instance-optimal rate of $O(\kappa \varepsilon^2)$. For fixed $\varepsilon > 0$, we prove that DRO still achieves the minimax rate if the problem has bounded residual effective rank. translated_title: 遗憾最优的Wasserstein鲁棒线性回归
translated_abstract: 分布鲁棒优化（DRO）在分布不确定性下最小化最坏情况风险，但其决策在超额风险（即遗憾）方面可能是次优的。我们针对多元最小二乘回归研究这一差距，假设观测到的源分布与未知的目标分布之间存在大小为 ε 的对抗性 2-Wasserstein 扰动。我们首先确定了在 ε→0 极限下鲁棒决策的渐近复杂度，该复杂度由一个问题特定的条件数 κ 刻画。在此情形下，包括 DRO 在内的众多简单算法均可达到实例最优的 O(κε²) 速率。对于固定的 ε>0，我们证明当问题具有有界的残差有效秩时，DRO 仍能达到极小极大速率。另一方面，我们识别出 DRO 被证明以依赖于维度的因子次优的显著失效模式。幸运的是，我们证明……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文刻画了在Wasserstein扰动下多元最小二乘回归中分布鲁棒优化（DRO）的遗憾性能，证明其在小扰动极限和有界残差有效秩情形下能达到实例最优或极小极大速率，同时也识别出DRO按维度相关因子次优的失效模式。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the regret of distributionally robust optimization (DRO) for Wasserstein-perturbed multivariate least-squares regression, showing that DRO achieves instance-optimal and minimax rates in certain regimes while identifying failure modes where it is provably suboptimal by dimension-dependent factors.
